name: The Snow Globe
source:
Bianca lives with her aunt and uncle. On a Winters night she receives two gifts - one of which is a snow globe with a young boy inside.

Will Bianca be able to help Yuki and make a friend along the way?

[From [url=https://katiemay.itch.io/the-snow-globe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
比安卡与她的姑妈和叔叔住在一起。在一个冬天的夜晚，她收到了两件礼物——其中之一是一个雪球，里面有一个小男孩。

比安卡能够帮助由希并一路上结交朋友吗？

[来自[url=https://katiemay.itch.io/the-snow-globe]Itch.io[/url]]
